headline: Houthis strike oil refinery in Saudi Arabia
summary: Yemen's Houthi movement, Ansar Allah, said it struck an oil refinery in the Saudi city of Ras Tanura. The claim was reported by 24.kg.
why: Ras Tanura is one of the largest oil export terminals and refineries in the world, operated by Saudi Aramco. Any disruption there can affect global crude and refined product supply.
why_moved: A Houthi claim of a strike on a major Saudi refinery raises concern about disruption to Gulf oil and product supply. The input does not confirm any damage or output loss.
original_headline: Хуситы ударили по нефтеперерабатывающему заводу в Саудовской Аравии
